params.text:
Current state: the core rebuild is green (all 3 checks pass, 13/13 claims hold) but the work is NOT feature-complete. 16 parity gaps are recorded as craft unknowns (see core-unknowns-show; highest severity first).

Top blocking gaps (all verified from app/src, not guessed):
1. No Logger (grep logger: 0 files) - HIGH
2. No project save/load (.burp) - HIGH
3. No HTTP/2 in the proxy (no h2 reference) - HIGH
4. Mechanics sheet claims 62/62 sourced, 0 estimated - needs re-verification - HIGH
5. No Match & Replace rules; Extensions tab is a 32-line stub; WebSocket history is 24 lines; scanner has ~20 passive checks + light active; no embedded browser; no Montoya extension runtime; no Organizer/BApp; Collaborator is not wired to the scanner.

Next: implement Logger and project save/load, add HTTP/2, then re-verify mechanics values against the decompiled functions. Keep the existing checks green after every increment (rebuild_check).

Environment: live original Burp Pro 2026.7.3 on Xvfb DISPLAY=:99 (verify with DISPLAY=:99 xwininfo -root -tree). Rebuild GUI also on Xvfb :95 via /root/erwin/bin/craft-build (zink+lavapipe). Router v2 at 127.0.0.1:8091, Bifrost admin 127.0.0.1:8099. Target is JVM bytecode: use java_* tools, never native_* on the JAR.
